Container.Name: BookmarkRanger
Container.Overview: A self-hosted bookmarks and code snippet manager.
Container.Description: BookmarkRanger is a self-hosted manager for bookmarks and code snippets: organize bookmarks into boards and categories, keep a tagged snippet library with syntax highlighting, pin favorites to a customizable dashboard, and publish curated collections to public share pages. Uses a built-in SQLite database — no separate database container required.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port BookmarkRanger will be accessible on.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Directory where the SQLite database and session data are stored.

Config.Name: Backups Volume
Config.Description: Directory where manual and automatic database backups are stored.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Complex secret used to sign session cookies.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Base path for serving on a sub-path (e.g. /bookmarkranger), leave empty to serve from root.
